blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative models enable unrestricted adversarial attacks that aim to fool classifiers while preserving the natural appearance and semantics of the original image. However, existing diffusion-based black-box attacks largely rely on transferability from surrogates, making their effectiveness sensitive to differences between surrogate and victim. Improving transferability can also distort semantic content and degrade image quality. Moreover, retaining the original prompt to preserve fidelity leaves the diffusion model's conditional prior underused for adversarial guidance. We address these limitations by adapting score-based black-box attacks to reverse diffusion, using the victim's output probabilities to guide latent updates without accessing its gradients. We further introduce adaptive-target guidance, which uses the victim's current runner-up class as an adversarial condition to steer denoising towards the decision boundary. Because such guidance can introduce unwanted semantic changes, we also propose target-search guidance, which searches for a small perturbation of the original condition embedding using a score-based attack. This achieves comparable attack effectiveness with better image quality than runner-up guidance. Experiments on the ImageNet-Compatible dataset show that our framework outperforms transfer-based baselines in both attack effectiveness and image quality.
blocks.zh: 基因模型可以实现无限制的对抗攻击,目的是在保持原始图像的自然外观和语义的同时愚弄分类者. 然而,现有的以传播为主的黑匣子攻击很大程度上依赖于代孕者的可转移性,使得其有效性对被代孕者和被代孕者之间的差异具有敏感性. 提高可传输性也可以扭曲语义内容并降低图像质量. 此外,保留原有的保持忠诚的提示,使得扩散模式有条件的事先未充分用于对抗性指导。 我们通过调整基于分数的黑盒攻击以反向扩散,利用受害人的输出概率来引导潜在的更新而不访问其梯度来应对这些限制. 我们进一步引入了适应性目标指导,将受害人目前的跑步类作为对抗条件,以向决定边界方向发号施令。 由于这种指导可以引入不想要的语义变化,我们还提出目标搜索指导,利用分数攻击来搜索原始条件嵌入的微小扰动. 这比起跑道向导,在图像质量上实现了可比较的攻击效果. 在ImageNet-兼容数据集上的实验表明,我们的框架在攻击效果和图像质量方面都超过了基于传输的基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Despite their remarkable performance in visual recognition, deep neural networks (DNNs) are vulnerable to imperceptible perturbations on benign inputs that induce erroneous predictions [ 43 ] , which pose severe security risks to safety-critical applications [ 1 ] . Many attacks [ 6 , 18 , 32 , 37 , 33 , 29 ] optimize such perturbations to deceive perception models while preserving visual fidelity. Unlike classical attacks under ℓ p \ell_{p} -norm constraints, Song et al. [42] introduced unrestricted adversarial examples (UAEs), which synthesize semantically plausible inputs with generative priors [ 35 ] to match human perception and evade defenses [ 52 , 40 ] . It was later extended to non- ℓ p \ell_{p} perturbations, including spatial displacement [ 46 ] , texture manipulation [ 4 ] and color shifts [ 4 , 24 , 39 , 53 , 49 ] . Diffusion models [ 22 , 38 ] further enable photorealistic UAEs by perturbing the denoising trajectory [ 12 ] . However, these methods assume white-box access to the victim, which rarely holds in practice and motivates black-box attacks [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 尽管在视觉识别方面表现显著,但深层神经网络(DNNs)在诱发错误预测的良性输入上容易受到无法察觉的干扰[43],这给安全关键应用造成了严重的安全风险[1]. 许多攻击[6,18,32,37,33,29]优化了这种扰动来欺骗感知模型,同时保持视觉忠心. 不像古典攻击 li p\ell\p} -norm controls, Song et al. [42] 引入了不受限制的对抗性例子(UAEs),这些例子用基因学前科合成了精密可信的投入[35],与人类认知相匹配并逃避了防御[52,40]. 它后来被扩展为非-l p\ell_{p}扰动,包括空间迁移[46],纹理操纵[4]和色调[4,24,39,53,49]. 扩散模型[22,38]通过干扰去诺能轨迹[12]进一步使光能现实化的阿联酋得以实现. 然而,这些方法假设白盒可以接触被害者,这在实际操作中很少持有并激发出黑盒攻击 [36].

blocks.en: In black-box settings, recent diffusion-based attacks largely follow the transfer-based paradigm, crafting adversarial examples on white-box surrogate models with specialized objectives [ 8 , 10 , 27 , 11 ] . Their efficacy, however, fluctuates with the architectural alignment between the surrogate and the victim. Optimizing UAEs for high transferability also introduces visual semantics of the target class, compromising stealthiness [ 50 ] . Furthermore, to preserve visual fidelity, existing methods restrict the condition to a null token or the original label, and thus do not exploit the conditional prior of the diffusion model to steer the reverse process towards the decision boundary.
blocks.zh: 在黑盒设置中,最近的以传播为主的攻击基本遵循了以转移为主的范式,在具有专门目标的白盒替代模型上设计了对抗性的例子[8,10,27,11]. 然而,其效力随着代孕者与被害者之间的建筑相通而波动. 优化阿联酋的高可转移性,也引入了目标类的视觉语义,会损害隐性 [50]. 此外,为了保持视觉上的忠诚,现有方法将条件限制在一无是处或原有的标签上,因此不利用扩散模型之前的有条件条件来引导逆向过程向决定边界的方向走去。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first framework that integrates score-based black-box attacks into the reverse diffusion process, which avoids the surrogate mismatch and semantic distortion of transfer-based attacks by crafting UAEs tailored to each victim. By querying the scores of the victim instead of a surrogate, we align the perturbation with the decision boundary of the victim while keeping the image natural, as Figure 1 illustrates. Specifically, we adapt six score-based attacks [ 19 , 3 , 25 , 26 , 30 , 2 ] from the pixel space to the diffusion latent space, and study the latent bound, the number of inverted steps and the query budget per step.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们最充分地提出第一个将分数黑盒攻击纳入反向扩散过程的框架,这个框架通过针对每个被害者的特制阿联酋来避免转移攻击的代位错配和语义扭曲. 通过询问受害人的分数而不是代孕,我们把扰动与受害人的决定边界相配合,同时保持图像自然,如图一所显示. 具体来说,我们调整了从像素空间到扩散潜在空间的6个分数攻击[19, 3, 25, 26, 30, 2], 研究潜在约束, 倒转步骤的数量和每步的查询预算.

blocks.en: Building on this framework, we develop two alternative algorithmic variants that exploit the diffusion model’s conditional prior to address different limitations of adversarial sampling. Both derive adversarial conditions from victim queries alone and retain the same score-based latent attack: the selected guidance modifies denoising before each latent update. Adaptive-target guidance (ATG) strengthens the attack under tight query budgets by adding guidance from the victim’s current runner-up class to the original reconstruction guidance. Selecting this class requires one extra victim query per step, while the guidance itself is supplied by the diffusion model. However, guidance towards a competing class can introduce unwanted semantic changes. To limit these changes, target-search guidance (TSG) instead searches for a small perturbation of the original prompt embedding using a score-based attack. This strengthens the attack while largely preserving the image quality of the unguided framework, at the cost of additional condition-search queries.
blocks.zh: 在这个框架的基础上,我们开发出两个备选的算法变体,在解决对抗性取样的不同局限性之前,利用扩散模型的条件。 两者都仅取自受害人的询问,并保留相同的分数潜在攻击:选定的指导在每次潜在更新之前都会修改去名。 适应性-目标指导(ATG)通过在最初的重建指导中增加目前受害者跑步班的指导,在紧张的查询预算下加强了攻击. 选择这一类需要每步额外一个受害者查询,而指导本身则由传播模型提供. 然而,指导一个相互竞争的阶层可以引入不必要的语义变化. 为了限制这些改变,目标搜索指针(TSG)取而代之的是利用分数攻击来搜索原始即时嵌入的微扰. 这加强了攻击,同时在很大程度上保留了无制导框架的图像质量,牺牲了额外的条件搜索查询.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We adapt score-based attacks to reverse diffusion to craft UAEs for each victim without a surrogate. Across eleven victims, our unguided strategy achieves 12.1% average accuracy and 59.6 FID with 720 queries per image, versus 17.7% and 72.0 for the strongest transfer-based baseline. • We introduce adaptive-target guidance (ATG) and target-search guidance (TSG). ATG reduces average accuracy by 4.1–15.3 percentage points across six attacks with one extra query per step. At Q = 60 Q=60 , TSG reduces accuracy by 5.9–24.6 points while increasing FID by at most 0.7. • We evaluate four adversarially trained models, where our strongest variants outperform transfer-based baselines in both accuracy and FID. On ResNet-50, our latent attack also outperforms the decision-based Latent-HSJA even when the latter receives ten times our query budget.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Unrestricted adversarial examples [ 42 ] replace the L p L_{p} -norm constraint with the requirement that the image remains natural and preserves its semantics, and diffusion models have become the main prior for such examples. AdvDiffuser [ 9 ] and DiffPGD [ 48 ] apply gradient-based perturbations during denoising, AdvDiff [ 12 ] adds adversarial classifier guidance to the reverse process, and Zhang et al . [ 51 ] sample from the product of a victim distribution and a distance distribution. These attacks require victim gradients, whereas our framework uses queried probabilities to guide latent updates during reverse diffusion.
blocks.zh: 不受限制的对抗性例子[42] 以图像保持自然并保存其语义的要求取代了L p-_{p} - 规范约束,扩散模型已成为此类例子的主要先行. AdvDiffuser[9]和DiffPGD[48]在去诺时适用梯度扰动法,AdvDiff[12]在反向过程上增加了对抗分级器指导,而张等等从受害者分布和相距分布的产品上取出样本. [51]. 这些攻击需要受害人的梯度,而我们的框架则使用被质疑的概率来指导逆向扩散过程中的潜在更新。

blocks.en: Without access to the victim, transfer-based attacks craft adversarial examples on a white-box surrogate and rely on their transferability [ 36 ] . Perturbation-based attacks such as MI-FGSM [ 14 ] , DI-FGSM [ 47 ] , TI-FGSM [ 15 ] , PI-FGSM [ 17 ] and S 2 I-FGSM [ 31 ] improve transferability with momentum, input transformations and spectrum augmentation. Unrestricted attacks add dedicated designs for the same goal: NCF [ 49 ] searches natural color distributions with neighborhood search and initialization reset, DiffAttack [ 8 ] further deceives the diffusion model by distracting its attention, ACA [ 10 ] optimizes the latent on the natural-image manifold, and APA [ 27 ] aggregates gradients over diffusion steps. NatADiff [ 11 ] combines augmented classifier guidance with time-travel sampling, guided by a prompt that names both the true class and a pre-selected target class, and synthesizes each sample from noise instead of perturbing a given image. Their effectiveness depends on surrogate–victim alignment, and adversarial training can reduce transferability [ 44 ] . Our framework instead uses direct victim queries to guide both latent updates and adversarial conditioning.
blocks.zh: 在无法接触受害人的情况下,基于转移的攻击在白盒代孕上刻出对抗性的例子并依赖其可转移性[36]. 基于扰动的攻击如MI-FGSM [14],DI-FGSM [47],TI-FGSM [15],PI-FGSM [17]和S 2 I-FGSM [31] 以动力,输入转换和频谱增强来提高可转移性. 不受限制的攻击为同一目标增加了专用设计:NCF[49]用邻里搜索和初始化重置来搜索自然颜色分布,DiffAttack[8]通过分散注意力来进一步欺骗了扩散模型,ACA[10]优化了自然图像多面上的潜在,APA[27]汇总了梯度比扩散步骤. Natadiff [11] 将增强分级制导与时间旅行采样相结合,以一个同时标出真实类和预选目标类的提示为引导,并从噪声中合成出每个样本而不是扰动给定图像. 其有效性取决于替补-受害者协调,对抗性培训可降低可转移性[44]。 我们的框架则利用直接的受害人询问来指导潜在的更新和对抗性条件。

blocks.en: Query-based attacks instead observe the outputs of the victim. Decision-based attacks use only the predicted label [ 5 , 7 ] , whereas score-based attacks use the output probabilities to estimate the gradient or its sign, as in NES [ 25 ] , Bandits [ 26 ] , ZOsignSGD [ 30 ] and SignHunter [ 2 ] , or to accept sampled updates, as in SimBA [ 19 ] and Square [ 3 ] . These methods typically perturb pixels within an L p L_{p} ball and can require thousands of queries per image [ 54 ] . A few attacks combine queries with a generative model. Latent-HSJA [ 34 ] runs HopSkipJumpAttack in the latent space of a GAN, and AdvDiffEdit [ 45 ] edits images with a diffusion model under accept or reject feedback, both observing only the decision. AdvFlow [ 13 ] applies NES in the latent space of a normalizing flow, but maps each latent to an image in one pass and projects it into an L p L_{p} ball. Our framework instead uses victim probabilities to update diffusion latents across successive denoising steps, without imposing a final pixel-space L p L_{p} constraint.
blocks.zh: 以查询为基础的攻击则观察受害者的结果。 基于决定的攻击只使用预测的标签[5,7],而基于分数的攻击则使用输出概率来估计梯度或其标志,如NES [25],"盗贼" [26],"ZOsignSGD [30]"和"SignHunter [2]",或者接受被抽样更新,如SimBA [19]和Square [3]. 这些方法一般会使L p-_{p}的球内有像素,每个图像可能需要上千个查询[54]. 少数攻击将询问与基因模型相结合. blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Following DiffAttack [ 8 ] , we use the ImageNet-Compatible Dataset [ 28 ] of 1000 ImageNet validation images and the same eleven victims, comprising five CNNs, four vision Transformers and two MLP-Mixers, plus four adversarially trained models in Section 5.6 .
blocks.zh: 在DiffAttack [8]之后,我们使用1000个ImageNet验证图像的图像网兼容数据集[28]和同样的11名被害者,包括5个CNN,4个视觉变形器和2个MLP-Mixers,外加第5.6节中4个经过对抗训练的模型.

blocks.en: We denote the six adapted attacks, NES, ZOsignSGD, Square, SimBA, SignHunter and Bandits, by the prefix Latent and evaluate each on its own, with ATG at scales 1.5 and 2.5, and with TSG at Q c = 60 Q_{c}=60 . We compare with the transfer-based attacks PI-FGSM, S 2 I-FGSM, NCF, DiffAttack, ACA [ 10 ] , APA with its SG and GC variants, and NatADiff [ 11 ] , which synthesizes each sample from the class label instead of perturbing the clean image, so its examples have no clean reference. For transfer-based attacks, we average each victim’s accuracy over all other models used as surrogates. We further compare with the decision-based Latent-HSJA [ 34 ] , which observes only the predicted label, starts from an image of another class and moves along the decision boundary towards the original image. We adapt it to our framework by running it on the DDIM-inverted latent and generating each candidate with the remaining denoising steps. As it follows a different attack paradigm, it is not the main focus of our comparison, and we evaluate it separately on ResNet-50.

blocks.en: 5.2 Performance of Latent Score-Based Attacks
blocks.zh: 5.2 后期计分攻击的表现

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , under both budgets, every unguided latent score-based attack achieves lower FID than all baselines, with FID between 57.6 and 62.7, whereas the baseline with the lowest FID, ACA, reaches 64.8. Several of our attacks also outperform the strongest transfer-based baseline using limited victim queries. With Q = 60 Q=60 queries per active step, the strongest strategy, Latent-ZOsignSGD, lowers the average accuracy to 21.3%, below that of APA-SG, the second-strongest transfer-based attack, on all eleven victims. With Q = 120 Q=120 , 4 of the 6 strategies, NES, ZOsignSGD, SignHunter and Bandits, outperform on average the strongest transfer-based attack APA-GC, which has the worst FID of 72.0 among all unrestricted attacks, with accuracies of 12.1% to 16.7% against 17.7%. This advantage may arise from the scores of the victim, which steer the search towards its own decision boundary, and to the remaining denoising steps, which refine each latent perturbation into natural image content.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,在这两个预算下,每一次无制导的潜在分数攻击的FID比所有基线都低,而FID在57.6至62.7之间,而FID最低的基线ACA为64.8。 我们的几次袭击还利用有限的受害者询问,超过了最强的转移基准。 以Q=每活步60QQ60查询,最强策略"Lateant-ZOsignSGD"将平均准确度降低到21.3%,低于APA-SG,以转移为主的第二强攻击,针对所有11名受害者. Q=120 QQ120,6个战略中的4个,NES、ZOsignSGD、SignHunter和Bandits平均比最强的转移式攻击超过APA-GC,在所有不受限制的攻击中,最高的FID为72.0,其速率为12.1%至16.7%,而为17.7%。 这一优势可能来自受害人的分数,这些分数将搜索引向自己的决定界限,以及剩余的去名步骤,这些步骤将每个潜在的扰动精炼成自然图像内容。

blocks.en: Strategies that perturb all latent coordinates in every query are the most effective. The gradient estimators NES and ZOsignSGD and the sign-based SignHunter reach average accuracies of 21.3% to 24.2% at Q = 60 Q=60 and 12.1% to 14.3% at Q = 120 Q=120 , followed by Bandits. Strategies built on local or sparse updates fall behind, with Square at 37.7% and 24.1% and SimBA, which perturbs a single coordinate at a time, at 79.6% and 70.8%. These results favor dense latent updates under the tested query budgets.
blocks.zh: 干扰每个查询中所有潜在坐标的战略最为有效。 梯度估计器NES和ZOsignSGD以及以标志为主的SignHunter在Q=60 Q=60时达到21.3%至24.2%的平均速率,在Q=120 Q=120时达到12.1%至14.3%,其次是"强盗". 基于当地或稀有更新的战略落后,Square为37.7%和24.1%,SimBA为一次扰动单一坐标,为79.6%和70.8%。 这些结果有利于在测试的查询预算中进行密集的潜在更新。

blocks.en: 5.3 Performance of Adaptive-Target Guidance
blocks.zh: 5.3 适应目标指导的执行情况

blocks.en: Adaptive-target guidance consistently strengthens every strategy under both budgets in Table 1 , lowering the average accuracy by 4.1% to 8.0% across all latent score-based attacks at s = 1.5 s=1.5 and by 5.6% to 15.3% at s = 2.5 s=2.5 . With s = 2.5 s=2.5 , Latent-ZOsignSGD reaches 6.1% at Q = 120 Q=120 , about a third of the accuracy of APA-GC, and 9 of the 12 settings outperform APA-GC, compared with 4 without guidance.

blocks.en: This gain is accompanied by FID increases across all latent score-based attacks of 2.1 to 4.5 at s = 1.5 s=1.5 and by 5.4 to 9.3 at s = 2.5 s=2.5 . At s = 1.5 s=1.5 , Latent-NES and Latent-ZOsignSGD already reach 8.5% and 7.9% at Q = 120 Q=120 with FID of 63.2 and 63.0, still below every transfer-based attack. blocks.en: 5.4 Performance of Target-Search Guidance
blocks.zh: 5.4 目标搜索指南的执行情况

blocks.en: Target-search guidance strengthens every strategy with small changes in FID. Compared with the unguided attacks at Q = 60 Q=60 , it lowers the average accuracy by 5.9% to 24.6% yet raises FID by at most 0.7, whereas adaptive-target guidance raises FID by 2.1 to 9.3. Under the same latent budget, TSG attains lower accuracy than ATG at s = 1.5 s=1.5 for five of the six strategies, with an FID that is 1.6 to 4.5 lower. With TSG, Latent-SignHunter, Latent-ZOsignSGD and Latent-NES reach 13.2%, 15.4% and 16.3% at FID of 62.7, 60.1 and 60.1, outperforming APA-GC in both accuracy and image quality.
blocks.zh: 目标搜索指导通过FID的微小变化来强化每一个策略. 与Q = 60 Q=60的无制导攻击相比,它将平均精度降低5.9%至24.6%,但将FID最多提高0.7,而适应性-目标制导将FID提高2.1至9.3。 在同样的潜在预算下,在6个战略中的5个战略中,TSG的精度低于ATG(s=1.5 s=1.5),其FID为1.6至4.5。 与TSG,Latent-SignHunter,Latet-ZOsignSGD和Latet-NES在627,60.1%和60.1%的FID中达到13.2%,15.4%和16.3%,在准确性和图像质量上都比APA-GC差.

blocks.en: Since TSG requires up to 61 additional victim queries per step on the condition, we further compare it with the unguided attacks at Q = 120 Q=120 , which use a comparable total query budget. The search-based strategies benefit more from devoting half of the budget to the condition, as SignHunter, Square and SimBA reach 13.2%, 22.4% and 55.0% against 14.3%, 24.1% and 70.8%, whereas the gradient estimators NES, ZOsignSGD and Bandits gain more from a larger latent budget. In all cases, FID stays within 0.7 of the unguided attacks. TSG therefore mitigates the quality degradation of ATG while still strengthening the attack, offering the best balance between effectiveness and stealthiness among our variants.

blocks.en: Among the examples in Figure 3 , ACA regenerates the image content, inserting an additional aircraft and re-rendering the scenes around the van, the tank and the motorcyclist, while APA-SG and APA-GC keep the layout but add visible artifacts such as a distorted brick wall and scribble-like patterns on the racetrack. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we adapted score-based black-box attacks to the reverse diffusion process to craft unrestricted adversarial examples tailored to each victim model, and strengthened them with adaptive-target guidance (ATG) and target-search guidance (TSG). Our attacks surpassed the strongest transfer-based attacks in both effectiveness and image quality, also on adversarially trained models. ATG yielded the strongest attacks, while TSG improved effectiveness at nearly unchanged image quality.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调整了基于分数的黑盒攻击,使之适应反向传播过程,以制定适合每个受害者模式的不受限制的对抗性实例,并用适应性目标指导(ATG)和目标搜索指导(TSG)来加强这些实例。 我们的攻击在效力和图像质量方面都超过了最强的转移攻击,而且也是对受过对抗训练的模型的攻击。 ATG产生了最强的攻击,而TSG则以几乎不变的图像质量提高了效能.

blocks.en: We compare image quality of results from different methods. Tab. 10 complements FID, which compares distributions, with metrics computed on every image. The full-reference metrics compare each adversarial example with its clean image. PSNR measures the pixel error, SSIM, MS-SSIM and FSIM the similarity of local structures, and LPIPS, DISTS and TOPIQ-FR the similarity of deep features, which follows human judgments of perceptual similarity. The no-reference metrics NIQE and BRISQUE measure how far a single image deviates from the statistics of natural images. NatADiff differs from the other attacks in how it generates examples, as it synthesizes each example from the class label instead of editing the clean image, so its full-reference metrics compare two different images of the same class. All metrics are computed at 224 × 224 224\times 224 . As for FID in Tab. 1 , each transfer-based attack is averaged over the examples crafted on its nine surrogates, and each of our attacks over the examples generated against the eleven victims.

blocks.en: We use a simplified example to demonstrate the process of our methods. Figure 5 runs the attacks on a mixture of three Gaussians, for which the noise prediction of each class is available in closed form. The victim is an MLP and the surrogate a linear classifier, both trained on samples of the mixture. A clean sample of y ori y_{\mathrm{ori}} is DDIM-inverted and then reversed with an untargeted attack on x ^ 0 | t \hat{x}_{0|t} before every step and once after the last step, in the same order as our attack on images. The transfer-based attack follows the gradient of the surrogate and crosses the decision boundary of the surrogate but not that of the victim. The score-based attack estimates the gradient of the victim with NES from 8 queries per step, but every DDIM step pulls the sample back towards p ⁡ ( x ∣ y ori ) p(x\mid y_{\mathrm{ori}}) , so it stays in the region of y ori y_{\mathrm{ori}} . ATG with s = 0.5 s=0.5 towards the runner-up class and TSG, which searches the condition with 8 queries per step, shift the reverse process itself, and both cross the decision boundary of the victim. Over 100 clean samples, the victim is fooled in 29%, 10%, 100% and 49% of the runs of the transfer-based attack, the score-based attack, ATG and TSG, respectively.
